direct_target.name: platform_delivery_direct
direct_target.source: PNADc special platform modules, certified upstream

historical_application.periods: All certified regular-quarterly periods in the upstream historical lock
historical_application.claim_ceiling: Reconstrução retrospectiva probabilística agregada da compatibilidade histórica com entrega por plataforma, calibrada em 2022T4/2024T3, com incerteza e suporte explicitados.

primary_models.mapping_2022: Survey-weighted L2 logistic regression trained on 2022, internally calibrated by PSU-fold isotonic regression
primary_models.mapping_2024: Survey-weighted L2 logistic regression trained on 2024, internally calibrated by PSU-fold isotonic regression
primary_models.mapping_pooled: Survey-weighted L2 logistic regression trained on pooled 2022+2024, internally calibrated by PSU-fold isotonic regression

auxiliary_models.weighted_mca: Weighted multiple correspondence analysis used only for support and extrapolation diagnostics
auxiliary_models.mca_clustering: K-means on MCA coordinates used only for occupational typologies
auxiliary_models.weighted_knn: Distance- and survey-weighted KNN used only as a non-parametric benchmark

uncertainty.survey: Stratum-PSU linearization conditional on model predictions
uncertainty.model: PSU bootstrap with logistic and isotonic refit
uncertainty.transport: Sensitivity range across mapping_2022, mapping_2024 and mapping_pooled
uncertainty.support: Reported separately as STRONG, MODERATE, WEAK or OUT_OF_SUPPORT

support_classes.STRONG: Exact feature cell observed in both 2022 and 2024
support_classes.MODERATE: Exact feature cell observed in one calibration year or close to calibration support
support_classes.WEAK: Feature cell within the outer calibration-distance envelope but not exactly observed
support_classes.OUT_OF_SUPPORT: Unseen category or feature cell beyond the support-distance gate

prohibited_claims: Individual direct platform identification in historical regular PNADc
Observed historical count of platform workers outside special modules
Cluster interpreted as a platform label
KNN estimate treated as the official series
Transport range described as a confidence interval
Thresholded proxy class treated as direct observation
